probability.source: Salesforce report 'Stage entry to close', FY2026 (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30): 31 of 388 opportunities that entered Discovery closed-won
Same FY2026 stage-entry report: 29 of 171 opportunities that entered Qualification closed-won
Same FY2026 stage-entry report: 27 of 87 opportunities that entered Solution closed-won
Same report: 24 of 50 Proposal entries won (48%). Five of those wins came from the one-off Q4 FY2026 pricing promotion; without them it is 19 of 45 (42%). Set between the two.
Only 19 opportunities reached Negotiation in FY2026 (14 won, 74%), too few to pin a rate; bounded by the 55-85% seen across FY2024 to FY2026
9 of 10 Closing-stage deals won in FY2026, one lost to a procurement freeze; ten deals cannot pin a rate, so it is bounded at 75-95%
